title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 22. Expresses deep concern about the intensified military-technical cooperation between Russia and China, which poses a growing threat to stability in the Indo-Pacific and beyond, and risks undermining global peace, the rules-based international order and European security interests; notes with concern the dependency of the EU and its Member States on imports of rare earth elements and other critical raw materials from third countries, in particular China, which constitutes a growing security risk; regrets that recent Russia-China military signalling and exercises, as well as China’s ‘Justice Mission 2025’ exercise, have further increased tensions in the region, reinforcing the importance of de-escalation, deterrence and the protection of freedom of navigation;
